The '''Ignition Crate''' is a special time-limited crate. It contains only crate-exclusive units; although [[Mantis]] and [[Duneshredder]] can also be found in the [[Overdrive Crate]], none of them can be obtained in normal supply drops.

Cost: 60 Volt Coins per open

Contents:
* [[Caledonia]] x1 (unique to this crate)
* [[Cassowary]] x2 (unique to this crate)
* [[Bullfrog]] x2 (unique to this crate)
* [[Metis]] x4 (unique to this crate)
* [[Intrepid]] x4 (unique to this crate)
* [[Marine]] x4 (unique to this crate)
* [[Firewall]] x8 (unique to this crate)
* [[Stealth Drone]] x8 (unique to this crate)
* [[Mantis]] x8 (this crate or [[Overdrive Crate]] only)
* [[Duneshredder]] x8 (this crate or [[Overdrive Crate]] only)
